answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in vine, verified in timber, and vertex names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 350 aliases cost 328 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
